hook: March a herd in single file: every Lemming that falls makes whoever is in front stronger.
loop: Order your line: who leads, who falls first, who inherits.
Onward deaths feed the Lead; Takes the lead units wait behind.
Your last Lead arrives huge, or Pups and Boom flood the board.

growth.line: Mostly in fight as Lemmings die; Brother Onward, Tent-Striker and Boom add permanent stats later.

feel.early: Pilgrims and Banner-Bearer feed a small front.
feel.mid: Front Lemming laps the lead; Pups start piling up.
feel.late: Death payoffs: Rune-Carver, Old Mother, Chorus hit huge.

stars.why: Passes the lead down the line, re-firing every Takes the lead card.
Kill your own Lead; the next one inherits its stats.
The whole tribe on a Tier 1: fall, push the front forward.

card_short.u04: Start of Turn: gives you a Pup in hand.
card_short.u05: Each turn, Lead grows permanently per Lemming next to it.
card_short.u06: Takes the lead: gains half the biggest enemy's Attack.
card_short.u07: Kills your Lead at fight start; next Lead inherits its stats.
card_short.u08: Twice a fight: a Lemming dies, summon a Pup.
card_short.u09: Twice a fight: Lemming taking the lead grows permanently.
card_short.u10: Lead passes down the line after each surviving attack.
card_short.u11: When your Lead dies, a Pup takes its slot.
card_short.u12: Start of Turn: your other Lemmings grow permanently.
card_short.u13: Gold when you get a copy of a unit you own.
card_short.u14: Stats gained from Onward become permanent.
card_short.u15: Each Lemming death deals 4 damage to the biggest enemy.
card_short.u16: Start of Turn: Boom grows, so every Pup grows.
card_short.u17: New Leads gain stats for each Lemming dead this fight.
card_short.u18: Each Lemming death buffs your other Lemmings.
card_short.u19: Lemmings grow permanently from last fight's death count.

builds.name: The Front
builds.line: Pile Onward gifts on one Lead; Brother Onward makes them stick.

builds.name: The Tide
builds.line: Flood with Pups; Midwife, Chorus and Old Mother pay each death.

builds.name: The Cliff
builds.line: Cliff-Singer kills your own Lead to fire Onward and pass stats.

liked: Front Lemming's lead rotation re-fires every Takes the lead card; the tribe's best idea.
Cliff-Singer: a sacrifice that keeps the stats, and works on any tribe's unit.
worries: No limits on Chorus, Old Mother or Rune-Carver; death engines make huge in-fight ceilings.
Also watched: golden Front Lemming, Breeder's economy, Herald's Boom, The One Who Arrived.
changed: Lead rule now says where the lead goes when your Lead dies.
New Boom keyword: one shared Pup bonus that halves when you lose.
Front Lemming now passes the lead only if the Lead survives attacking.
verdict: Fun 7.3, distinct 7, ranked second of three in its seed; for players who enjoy line-order puzzles and death triggers.
